name: iclas-fullstack
description: ICLAS - Intelligent Corporate & Leadership Advisory System (Full Stack Node.js + React)

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
